popcorn.lore.rare: Hides one unpopped kernel in every handful, waiting for the softest tooth.

taco.lore.rare: Shatters into so many pieces at the first bite that the plate ends up with more taco than the mouth.

x_apple_pie.lore.epic: Was left to cool on a windowsill, and three neighbours and a fox turned up to admire it.

x_gyro.lore.rare: Gets wrapped so tightly that the last bite squirts sauce right up its eater's sleeve.

x_pizza_slice_box.lore.legendary: Fed a whole party from one box, and somehow there was still a slice left for the pizza delivery rider.

x_quesadilla_plate.lore.uncommon: Lets one wedge slide off the plate every time it is carried to the table.
x_quesadilla_plate.lore.rare: Hides a pocket of molten cheese in its middle wedge, so whoever gets it gasps.
x_quesadilla_plate.lore.epic: Was cut into so many wedges at a party that it looked like a giant golden clock.

x_shawarma.lore.rare: Turns on its spit so hypnotically that the whole queue forgets what it was going to order.
